items.stem: Before a cloud agent's changes reach a branch, what should be in place?

options.text: Human review and an approval gate
options.rationale: Correct: review and an approval gate stop unreviewed changes from merging.
Auto-merge removes the safety of review.
Broad credentials increase risk, not safety.

options.text: Nothing; cloud agents are trusted by default
options.rationale: No agent output should merge untrusted.

items.explanation: Correct: review and an approval gate stop unreviewed changes from merging.

items.stem: Which TWO settings govern team cloud agent use responsibly? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Cost and scope limits on runs
options.rationale: Correct: limits prevent runaway cost and over-broad changes.

options.text: An audit trail of what runs did
options.rationale: Correct: auditing lets a team see and review agent actions.

options.text: Unlimited budget per run for speed
Shared admin credentials for every run
options.rationale: Shared admin access defeats least privilege and auditing.

items.explanation: Correct: limits prevent runaway cost and over-broad changes.

items.stem: A cloud agent run is drifting away from the task. What is the right action?

options.text: Interrupt it and re-scope the task
options.rationale: Correct: steering a drifting run back on task avoids wasted, wrong work.

options.text: Let it finish and review everything later
options.rationale: An unattended drifting run wastes cost and produces wrong output.

options.text: Give it more access so it can recover itself
options.rationale: More access does not fix a scoping problem.
Merging drifted output ships wrong changes.

items.explanation: Correct: steering a drifting run back on task avoids wasted, wrong work.
